title: fix(hooks): HEAD-based marker so multiple prove-its work in one session
subtitle: PR #39 — butverify/cmd/bv
summary: The stop hook now stores the git HEAD hash in the session-proven marker. A new commit after proving invalidates the marker, requiring a fresh prove-it cycle. Previously a single prove-it would clear the hook for the entire session regardless of how many commits followed.

metadata.issue_title: fix(hooks): HEAD-based marker so multiple prove-its work in one session

items.title: Hook behavior: all 4 scenarios
items.description: bv install-skill generates the HEAD-based script. Scenario 1: no marker → blocks (exit 2). Scenario 2: marker = current HEAD → allows silently (exit 0, marker deleted). Scenario 3: stale marker (old HEAD) → blocks again. Scenario 4: non-git context → accepts any non-empty marker.

items.title: Test suite: new HEAD-based assertions pass
items.description: TestStopHookScript_Shape now asserts the generated script contains 'git rev-parse HEAD', 'proven_ref', and 'current_ref'. Full cmd/bv suite passes.
